evidence.why: A fresh Helm install on 2.1.0 still fails with release: not found during the post-install hook.
A second report describes the same failure with matching steps and error text.

repro.notes: Install the chart into a clean namespace, then wait for the post-install hook.

notes: Prefer fixing over closing. The bug is still reproducible.
comment: Re-checked on [2.1.0](https://github.com/redhat-developer/rhdh/releases/tag/v2.1.0): the Helm install still fails with `release: not found` in a clean OpenShift 4.14 namespace. Keeping this open and recommending the Install team reproduces it on the current chart.
